FR-001.title: The health check MUST read the unrecorded-calls marker before deciding a spec has no trace evidence.

FR-002.title: Unrecorded calls with no trace file MUST be reported at problem severity, naming a reason verbatim.

FR-003.title: No marker and no trace file MUST still report the trace check as skipped, wording unchanged.

FR-004.title: The health check MUST report an implement step that completed with no verification recorded.

FR-005.title: The verification check MUST report no-record, not a problem, for a spec that never reached implement.

FR-006.title: A step start MUST be recorded before the assistant performs any of that step work.

FR-007.title: Recording a step start twice MUST NOT produce a second entry; the earlier timestamp wins.

FR-008.title: Every new check MUST degrade silently on a spec with no relevant record.

FR-009.title: Each behaviour MUST have an executable test that fails if the behaviour regresses.

decisions.decision: Read .trace-lost before check_trace returns its skip
decisions.why: the marker exists precisely for the case where the trace file could not be written, which is the case the early return currently swallows; _lost_entries already handles both paths and degrades to []
decisions.rejected: a separate lost check with its own status row, which would print a second skipped row on every healthy spec

decisions.decision: Add check_verification as its own registered check between completion and template
decisions.why: FR-005 wants no-record as a status, and only a registered check produces a CheckStatus skip; folding it into check_record forces a finding-or-nothing shape the spec rejects
decisions.rejected: judging every step, which would fire on plan and tasks where no execution is expected

decisions.decision: Hoist the step-start stamp into a shared step-start part fenced above speckit-hooks in all four step frames
decisions.why: the stamp sits inside a content node today, so pre-hooks and (for plan) size-budget run outside the window the step later claims; only a part at the top of the frame is first on the terminal and self-advance paths, not just the extension dispatch path
decisions.rejected: inlining the stamp into each frame, which is the forked shared rule check-shape-parity assertion (a) exists to catch

decisions.decision: Cover FR-007 with a test and change no code
decisions.why: _has_step_start already matches a prior start anywhere in the log and history[] is append-only, so the earliest start already wins; the hoist makes that guard load-bearing so it earns a regression test
decisions.rejected: adding an explicit earliest-wins comparison, a second mechanism enforcing the same invariant

decisions.decision: The step-start part covers both a known feature directory and a step that mints its own
decisions.why: specify and auto resolve the feature directory inside their first node, so at frame time there is nothing to stamp against; one part text has to be correct for all of them and stay byte-identical for the parity gate
decisions.rejected: fencing the part only into plan/tasks/implement, which would leave specify stamping late and the part text asymmetric

decisions.decision: auto/_frame.md got the step-start fence too
decisions.why: auto/resolve-dir.md now defers to the part, so without the fence in auto the reference pointed at nothing
decisions.rejected: leaving auto stamping inline, which reintroduces the duplicate the hoist removes

decisions.decision: The lost finding was extracted to _lost_finding and reused
decisions.why: the marker is now reported from two branches of check_trace; two copies of the same finding text is what drifts
decisions.rejected: duplicating the Finding construction in the early-return branch

decisions.decision: check_verification judges verified[] as empty-or-not and never reads entry contents
decisions.why: FR-005 wants no-record as a status, and interpreting what an entry claims is the drift check job
decisions.rejected: folding the finding into check_completion, which has no status of its own to report no-record with

decisions.decision: The shared .trace-lost fallback write now names its spec, and _lost_entries returns only attributable lines
decisions.why: the review found that hoisting the marker read made one spec unwritable-directory failure report as a problem on every trace-less spec in the repo, since the shared file carries no spec identity; tagging at the write is the root-cause fix rather than suppressing the read
decisions.rejected: excluding the shared marker entirely on the no-trace path, which would have silently dropped the exact scenario US1 exists for

decisions.decision: The step-start part leads with the mint-your-own-directory rule instead of treating it as the exception
decisions.why: the review found the usual-case branch would have specify and auto stamp against .specify/feature.json while it still points at the PREVIOUS spec, rewriting a prior spec status when that spec sat at currentStep specify
decisions.rejected: keeping the shorter two-branch wording, which read correctly only if you already knew which steps mint their own directory

plan.summary: Planned three wirings: read the trace-lost marker before the trace skip, add a verification check for an implement step that closed having proven nothing, and hoist the step-start stamp into a shared command part so a step window contains its own work.
plan.key_finding: None of the three needs a new mechanism. .trace-lost, verified[] and the duplicate-start guard all ship today; what is missing is a reader in two places and a placement change in the third.

tasks.summary: 23 tasks across 6 phases: empty Setup/Foundational, one phase per user story (trace marker read, verification check, step-start hoist), Polish with docs and one validation run.

implement.summary: Three doctor blind spots wired up: the trace check reads the unrecorded-calls marker before its early return, a new verification check names an implement step that closed having run nothing, and the step-start stamp moved into a shared part above every step hooks fence.

approach: Wire up three readers that already have their data. Move the .trace-lost read above check_trace's early return; add a verification check that reports an implement step which completed with an empty verified[]; hoist the step-start stamp out of the content nodes into a shared step-start part fenced at the top of every step frame, ahead of the extension hooks. FR-007 is already satisfied by the existing duplicate-start guard and needs only a regression test.
